statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-15 on Cloudreve 4.19.1. The advisory (GO-2023-2386) is a verification bypass in memoryStore.Verify of the newer API: a non-existent id with an empty answer and clear=true is accepted. Cloudreve pins base64Captcha at the 2019 commit 752b1cd608b2, which has no memoryStore.Verify; Cloudreve verifies with VerifyCaptcha (middleware/captcha.go:75), which calls VerifyCaptchaAndIsClear, and that returns false for an empty answer before it reads the store (captcha.go:111-113 of the pinned module) and otherwise compares the stored value case-insensitively. A non-existent id yields an empty stored value, which never equals a non-empty answer. v1.3.6 (the fix) removed ConfigCharacter, GenerateCaptcha and CaptchaWriteToBase64Encoding, which Cloudreve calls (service/basic/site.go:230-247), so the module cannot move without changing Cloudreve. Revisit when Cloudreve moves to the v1.3 API.
